skills.name: acl
skills.description: Use when the user wants to manage Zilliz Cloud access control -- custom org or project roles and their policies, granting or revoking a role for an organization member, or binding roles to a SCIM user group. This is cloud-level RBAC over organizations, projects, and clusters -- for database users and privileges inside Milvus see the user-role skill.
headings: One project's roles: the pre-defined project roles plus that project's
custom roles. --project-id is required; it is prompted for when omitted.
Org roles (--project-id is rejected here: org roles have no project boundary)
Lists the members, groups, and API keys the role is bound to.
skills.description_zh: 管理Zilliz Cloud组织和项目自定义角色及策略，授予或撤销成员角色并绑定SCIM用户组；属于云级RBAC，Milvus数据库内部用户权限使用user-role技能。

skills.name: ask-zilliz
skills.description:
Zilliz Cloud onboarding and usage assistant. Helps users understand Zilliz Cloud, choose the right plan, estimate costs, write code, debug issues, and adopt new features like Functions, Volumes, and Global Clusters.

Use this skill whenever the user asks about Zilliz Cloud — including plan selection, pricing, cost estimation, capacity planning, cluster configuration, SDK usage, schema design, search patterns, migration, troubleshooting, MCP server setup, Terraform, auto-scaling, metrics/alerts, backup/restore, or any "how do I do X with Zilliz Cloud" question. Also trigger when the user mentions keywords like: "Zilliz", "zilliz cloud", "vector database", "which plan", "serverless vs dedicated", "CU", "vCU", "Milvus cloud", "pymilvus", "collection", "embedding function", "hybrid search", "rerank", "BM25", "global cluster", "BYOC", "tiered storage", "volume", "data import", "MCP server", "partition key", or error messages from Zilliz Cloud.
headings: 1. Role: Experience Layer on Top of Inkeep
skills.description_zh: 提供Zilliz Cloud入门和使用支持，涵盖套餐与费用估算、容量及集群配置、SDK与schema、搜索和重排、迁移排错、MCP及Terraform、自动扩容、监控告警、备份恢复，以及Functions、Volumes和Global Clusters等功能。

skills.name: backup
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create, list, describe, delete, export, or restore backups, or manage backup policies on Zilliz Cloud.
skills.description_zh: 在Zilliz Cloud创建、列出、查看、删除、导出或恢复备份，并管理备份策略。

skills.name: billing
skills.description: Use when the user wants to check usage, view invoices, or manage payment methods on Zilliz Cloud.
skills.description_zh: 查看Zilliz Cloud用量和账单，并管理支付方式。

skills.name: cluster
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create, list, describe, delete, suspend, resume, or modify Zilliz Cloud clusters.
skills.description_zh: 创建、列出、查看、删除、暂停、恢复或修改Zilliz Cloud集群。

skills.name: collection
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create, list, describe, drop, rename, load, release, or manage collections and collection aliases in Milvus.
headings: -o table                          Render pivot table instead of the default inline chart
Period shorthand: last hour of SEARCH_QPS for a collection
Multiple metrics in a single call
skills.description_zh: 在Milvus创建、列出、查看、删除、改名、加载或释放集合，并管理集合别名。

skills.name: database
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create, list, describe, or drop databases in Milvus.
skills.description_zh: 在Milvus创建、列出、查看或删除数据库。

skills.name: diagnose
skills.description: Use when the user reports that a Zilliz Cloud cluster or Milvus collection is unhealthy, slow, stuck, returning errors, hitting quotas, or otherwise misbehaving — or when they ask "what's wrong with...", "why is ... slow", "diagnose ...", "troubleshoot ...".
headings: For each vector index reported above:
skills.description_zh: 诊断Zilliz Cloud集群或Milvus集合的不健康、变慢、卡住、错误和配额问题。

skills.name: external-collection
skills.description: Use when the user wants to trigger, describe, or list refresh jobs for an external collection (a collection backed by an external data source such as Vector Lake). Note this is the data-plane refresh workflow, not collection CRUD -- for create/drop/load see the collection skill.
headings: --external-source <src>       Override the external source registered on the collection
--external-spec <spec>        Override the external spec registered on the collection
skills.description_zh: 为Vector Lake等外部数据源支持的集合触发、查看或列出刷新任务，属于数据面的刷新流程；集合创建、删除及加载由collection技能处理。

skills.name: import
skills.description: Use when the user wants to import bulk data into a Milvus collection via Zilliz Cloud import jobs, or manage import stages (pre-uploaded file holders that import jobs reference).
skills.description_zh: 通过Zilliz Cloud导入任务将批量数据写入Milvus集合，并管理导入任务引用的预上传文件存储区。

skills.name: index
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create, list, describe, or drop indexes on Milvus collections.
skills.description_zh: 在Milvus集合上创建、列出、查看或删除索引。

skills.name: job
skills.description: Use when the user wants to check the status of an async Cloud Job (backup, restore, migration, import, or clone). Also use when the user wants to wait for a long-running operation to complete.
skills.description_zh: 查看备份、恢复、迁移、导入或克隆等异步云任务状态，并等待长时操作完成。

skills.name: monitoring
skills.description: Use when the user wants to check cluster status, collection statistics, load states, or get an overview of their Zilliz Cloud resources.
headings: For each collection, get stats and load state:
skills.description_zh: 检查Zilliz Cloud集群状态、集合统计和加载状态，或查看云资源概览。

skills.name: on-demand-cluster
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create, list, describe, or delete an on-demand (Vector Lake / VectorLake) cluster. On-demand clusters auto-suspend after an idle TTL and are intended for ad-hoc query workloads against a Vector Lake.
headings: Create an 8-CU on-demand cluster with the default 60s idle TTL
Keep alive 30 minutes between queries, cap query node CU and replicas
skills.description_zh: 创建、列出、查看或删除按需Vector Lake集群，用于临时查询工作负载；原说明集群在空闲TTL之后自动暂停。

skills.name: partition
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create, list, load, release, or drop partitions in a Milvus collection.
skills.description_zh: 在Milvus集合中创建、列出、加载、释放或删除分区。

skills.name: privatelink
skills.description: Use when the user wants to list available PrivateLink endpoint services, list/create/delete PrivateLink endpoints for a project, or manage the endpoint whitelist on Zilliz Cloud.
headings: Add region to PrivateLink endpoint whitelist
skills.description_zh: 列出Zilliz Cloud可用PrivateLink端点服务，在项目中创建、列出或删除端点，并管理端点白名单。

skills.name: project-region
skills.description: Use when the user wants to manage Zilliz Cloud projects or storage volumes. For cloud regions and providers, see the cluster skill.
skills.description_zh: 管理Zilliz Cloud项目或存储卷；云区域及提供商相关操作使用cluster技能。

skills.name: quickstart
skills.description: Use when the user wants to set up, install, authenticate, or configure the Zilliz Cloud CLI and cluster context for the first time (one-shot onboarding).
skills.description_zh: 首次配置Zilliz Cloud CLI和集群上下文，一次完成安装、认证及配置入门。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Use when the user needs to install zilliz-cli, log in to Zilliz Cloud, configure credentials, or set the active cluster context. Also use when any other skill reports a missing prerequisite.
skills.description_zh: 安装zilliz-cli、登录Zilliz Cloud、配置凭据并设置活动集群上下文，亦用于补齐其他技能报告的缺失前置条件。

skills.name: status
skills.description: Use when the user wants a comprehensive overview of their current Zilliz Cloud environment — context, cluster details, databases, and collections with stats.
skills.description_zh: 提供当前Zilliz Cloud环境的全面概览，包含上下文、集群详情、数据库及集合统计。

skills.name: user-role
skills.description: Use when the user wants to manage database users, roles, passwords, or access privileges in Milvus.
skills.description_zh: 管理Milvus数据库用户、角色、密码及访问权限。

skills.name: vector
skills.description: Use when the user wants to search, query, insert, upsert, get, or delete vectors in a Milvus collection.
skills.description_zh: 在Milvus集合中搜索、查询、插入、upsert、读取或删除向量。
